ValidationRule.description: Prevent updating parent opp with Status = Integration / Activation / Closed Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.Allowed_to_manually_Closed_Won__c = FALSE, $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, $Profile.Name!='Xendit API Profile', RecordType.Name = 'Child Opportunity', OR( ISNEW(), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), PRIORVALUE(Parent_Opportunity__c) != Parent_Opportunity__c ) ), NOT(ISBLANK( Parent_Opportunity__c )), OR( ISPICKVAL(Parent_Opportunity__r.StageName, "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Parent_Opportunity__r.StageName, "Activation") , ISPICKVAL(Parent_Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Won") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to assign the Opportunity to Parent with Stage as Integration / Activation / Closed Won
